title: The DAO of Cardano: a practical guide

ms.promise:
・Build a survey based on what we know about DAO creation and operation
・Reach out to the 35 DAOs listed as the DAOs of Cardano
・Compile the results of the surveys and calls with DAO members
・Put together a lesson plan and slides based on how the main issues can be solved from a marketing, legal, or fundraising perspective
・Creation of a link to an online subscription or newsletter that will allow people to be informed of results
・Start advertising the event
ms.criteria:
・Survey will contain questions identify what they wished they’d known, what they still wish they knew, and what turned out to be unimportant. ・A segmented and data-backed report on where problems and opportunities lie, as well as a qualitative assessment of the information.
・At least three slide decks covering the key topics id
